title: Dock of the Bay | Benchmark Management Vacation Rental
meta_description: Dock of the Bay is a 3.00 bedroom, 3.50 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Welcome to our newly renovated Rustic Dock of the Bay home, a charming cottage by Choctawhatchee Bay in South Walton County, Florida. This spacious retreat accommodates up to 10 guests, with direct beach access just a minute's walk from Kellogg Bayside Park, where you'll find a kayak launching ramp conveniently located right next door. Featuring 3 bedrooms and 3.5 bathrooms, this home offers ample space for your group. The first floor boasts a comfortable living area with large couches, a fireplace, and stunning water views. Step onto the spacious deck for outdoor dining and relaxation. The fully equipped kitchen includes modern appliances and a convenient island. The master bedroom on the first floor offers a king bed, balcony with beach chairs, and a luxurious full bathroom. Upstairs, the second bedroom features two queen beds and a balcony, while the third bedroom offers a bunk bed and twin beds, both with balconies overlooking the water. Additional amenities include a carport, propane BBQ grill, washer/dryer, and a lot more. With its impeccable amenities and prime location, this home promises an unforgettable coastal getaway.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS1st Floor - 1 king bed, TV, private bathroom2nd Floor - 2 queen beds, TV, private bathroom2nd Floor - 1 single bunked bed and 2 twin bedsBEACH ACCESSImmerse yourself in unparalleled coastal beauty as you step onto the deck and stroll along the private dock, indulging in panoramic views of Choctawhatchee Bay. With direct beach access mere steps away, you'll savor every moment of seaside bliss.Your stay at Dock of the Bay comes with Xplorie’s best activities! Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!* Parking for 3 cars, with 1 carport* Sorry, no pets allowed.* No smoking inside the house
